name: WTE QOL Loot Toasts
author: Unvios
description: Streamlines post-battle flow: the loot roll shows the die face as a free popup at the bottom center, items and gold appear as icon-only toasts at the bottom right, earned EXP arrives as a final toast, and the battle start announcements ("A Rat appears!") and "Victory!" window are skipped. All text stays localized; disabling the mod restores vanilla behavior.
